summary.text: Paul Weber is the independent candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 95, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Jill Billings and Republican Cedric Schnitzler.

paragraphs.text: Paul Weber received 934 votes, or 4.6%, in the August 11, 2020, Democratic primary for Wisconsin State Senate District 32, which Brad Pfaff won.
